_readme: Where Tell runs, as the home page lists it. LEAD: flip `shipped` to true (and fill `snippet`, `href`) when an integration lands; unshipped ones show 'coming in Wave 3' and no snippet.

items.name: GitHub Action
items.what: Checks every pull request that touches a .compact file. Findings appear in GitHub code scanning on the line that leaks; the build fails above the severity you choose.
items.snippet:
- uses: RohanGlitched/tell@v1
  with:
    path: contract
    fail-on: high

items.name: Command line
items.what: A readable report, JSON for scripts, SARIF for code scanning. Runs the compiler your pragma asks for.

items.name: Web scanner
items.what: Paste a contract or a public repository. Share a report as a link that carries the contract itself; nothing is stored.

items.name: README badge
items.what: Your repository's grade on its README, refreshed about once a day.

items.name: Pull-request review
items.what: A comment on the pull request with the finding, the bits it gives away and a verified patch to commit.

items.name: VS Code
items.what: Leaking lines marked as you write, with the bits and the fix on hover.

items.name: MCP server
items.what: AI agents that write Compact call Tell before proposing a contract, and apply the fix it returns.
